note: Owned by the pipeline (pipeline/sources.ts validates it). accessMethods are tried in order; see docs/PIPELINE.md. 'probe' records what a live request on the given date actually returned.

sources.name: DP World newsroom (UAE releases)

accessMethods.note: sitemap index of 9 child maps; <lastmod> is a crawl date, not a publication date

accessMethods.query: DP World UAE Jebel Ali Jafza logistics warehouse news

sources.notes: Listing redirects from /en/news/releases/uae/ to /en/news/uae and is rendered by JavaScript (Next.js): the HTML has no article links, so discovery falls back to the sitemap, then to site search.

results: GET https://www.dpworld.com/en/news/releases/uae/ -> 200 after redirect to /en/news/uae; ~2 MB HTML, ~2 KB readable text, no article links (JS-rendered)
robots.txt 200: allows /en/news/; disallows /api/, /_next/
sitemap.xml 200: sitemap index with 9 children; sitemap-0 and sitemap-1 (500 URLs each) contained no /en/news/uae/ URLs

sources.name: Jafza (Jebel Ali Free Zone) news
sources.notes: Server-rendered listing with dated article links; paginated (/page/2/).
